title: What Happens When AI Can Clone Any Game?
author: xenquish

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body: Millions of games, 1 percent of them good, gamers win.

comments.author: Xenobyte_VT
comments.body:
We "technically" already have this happening in all media except it's not with AI. People aren't creating anything really original they're creating derivative works inspired by originals. Every monster catcher game isn't adding anything new they're just different fonts of games that already exist i.e Palworld = Pokemon + Ark or Aniimo = Pokemon + Genshin. Then you have a bunch of RPG shooters that spawned from things like Mass Effect, Bioshock, Borderlands. The simple survivor games that spawned from the success of Vampire Survivors like 20 Minutes to Dawn, Brotato, etc...

Same thing can be said about things like anime and other animated media like the 2010s and 2020s animes are heavily based on things like the Big 3 and the Big 3 were inspired by stuff that predates them. 

We've produced so much media in the past 20 years that it's all just rinse, wash, and repeating the same formulas .
